import csv,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile
SRC='products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/'
F='products/services/catalogue-qa/fulfillment/'
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
for f in ['transform.py','verify.py','verify_example.py']: shutil.copy(SRC+f,d)
for f in ['v','i','ours']: shutil.copy(F+'synthetic-%s.csv'%f,d+'/%s.csv'%f)
res={'label':'SYNTHETIC PREPARATION ONLY','cases':{}}
def run(args):
  r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I']+args,cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
  return {'argv':args,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout[-1200:],'stderr':r.stderr[-800:]}
rows=list(csv.reader(open(d+'/v.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
rows[2][4]=rows[1][4]
with open(d+'/vd.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n').writerows(rows)
res['cases']['input_only_dup_sku_transform']=run(['transform.py','--variants','vd.csv','--images','i.csv','--out','od.csv','--report','rd.json'])
res['cases']['input_only_dup_sku_report_json']=open(d+'/rd.json',encoding='utf-8').read()[:1500] if os.path.exists(d+'/rd.json') else 'NO_REPORT'
res['cases']['input_only_dup_sku_output_written']=os.path.exists(d+'/od.csv')
res['cases']['input_only_valid_report_json']=(run(['transform.py','--variants','v.csv','--images','i.csv','--out','o2.csv','--report','r2.json']) and open(d+'/r2.json',encoding='utf-8').read()[:800])
b=list(csv.reader(open(d+'/ours.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
# extra Shopify column (realistic agency template)
x=[r[:1]+['Body (HTML)' if k==0 else '']+r[1:] for k,r in enumerate(b)]
with open(d+'/px.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n').writerows(x)
res['cases']['produced_extra_column']=run(['verify_example.py','v.csv','i.csv','px.csv'])
k=b[0].index('Image alt text')
y=[r[:k]+r[k+1:] for r in b]
with open(d+'/py.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n').writerows(y)
res['cases']['produced_missing_column']=run(['verify_example.py','v.csv','i.csv','py.csv'])
z=[list(r) for r in b]
with open(d+'/pz.csv','w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\r\n').writerows(z)
res['cases']['produced_crlf']=run(['verify_example.py','v.csv','i.csv','pz.csv'])
json.dump(res,open(F+'execution-results-2.json','w'),indent=1)
for kk,c in res['cases'].items():
  if isinstance(c,dict):
    try: fl=json.loads(c['stdout']).get('failed')
    except Exception: fl=c['stdout'][:150]
    print(kk,'exit',c['exit'],fl,'|',(c['stderr'].strip().splitlines() or [''])[-1][:200])
  else: print(kk,str(c)[:700])
